phases.title: Scaffold and rules
phases.description: Define the game model: board representation, turn order, win/draw detection, and valid-move rules.

tasks.desc: Implement board state (empty / X / O) and an API to apply moves.
Add win, loss, and draw checks after each move.

phases.title: User interface
phases.description: Let two players (or human vs local AI later) see the grid and play turns with clear feedback.

tasks.desc: Build a grid UI that shows current marks and whose turn it is.
Handle clicks or taps; reject illegal moves and show a short message.

phases.title: Polish and reset
phases.description: New game, end-state messaging, and light styling so the flow feels finished.

tasks.desc: Add a new game / play again control and reset state.
Tidy layout, accessible labels, and end-game banner (win/draw).
